changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0014. Staff, trainer, and member profiles extend a Part 2 user inside one tenant. They do not store passwords. BranchId is the primary branch only. Index review: PK on Id; UX_StaffProfiles_TenantId_UserId and the trainer and member equivalents stop a second active profile; UX employee and member codes are unique per tenant; IX_MemberProfiles_TenantId_Status supports member lists. Performance note: unique indexes are filtered so a removed profile can be recreated.
